1879060793.name: Sign of the Wild: Rage
1879060793.desc: This sign asks your animal friend to go into a rage, attacking faster and making itself look as threatening as possible. You cannot have more than one Sign of the Wild active on your companion at a time without the trait 'Master of Beasts'.

1879064249.name: Test of Will
1879064249.desc: Damages and stuns the target.\n\nThis skill has a large bonus to its Critical chance and magnitude.

1879064377.name: Low Cut
1879064377.desc: A low cut in front of you which briefly slows the movement speed of multiple enemies.

Anthem: Greatly increases your Cry and Call Damage.

Increases Light, Fire, Frost, and Lightning Damage of all nearby fellowship or raid members.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 1 ballad buff present on the Minstrel.</rgb>

1879215033.name: Poor Map to Grimwood
1879215033.desc: A poorly drawn and undetailed map to Grimwood.

1879222201.name: Map to Gramsfoot

1879227833.name: Ring of Shadow
1879227833.desc: Wield the power of Shadow to assault Saruman by creating a corrupt weakness to exploit.

1879244857.desc: A violent strike against the target that focuses on your offensive capability, dealing damage and increasing threat against the target.

1879245625.name: Debate the Land
1879245625.desc: A strength that all Rune-keepers possess is the ability to speak well on any subject. This proves to be a great benefit in the midst of a heated debate, and this benefit can prove very potent and effective.

1879247801.name: Swift Cut
1879247801.desc: A swift slice against an opponent dealing a little damage up front with a hefty bleed to follow.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Increases Fervour by 1</rgb>

1879254073.name: Keen Strike
1879254073.desc: A keen edged blade and razor wit can combine to truly potent effect. Burglars can take advantage of the stratagem trick with this keen strike.\n\n<rgb=#ff6600>This skill is enhanced by Trick: Stratagem.</rgb>

1879266873.name: Horn Blast
1879266873.desc: The Champion uses his battle-horn to drive fear into the hearts of his enemies and their steeds. \n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Fervour</rgb>

1879271865.name: Standard of Valour
1879271865.desc: Calls forth the Standard of Valour, dealing damage to enemies while increasing the Morale healed to nearby allies.

1879271993.name: Reform the Lines!
1879271993.desc: Take your place in the front lines to bolster morale and heal the Fellowship.\nThis skill temporarily makes you and your entire Fellowship act as though they are your Shield-brother, allowing everyone to benefit from effects which normally only affect your Shield-brother.

1879311289.name: Relentless Maul
1879311289.desc: You rear up and begin to thrash violently, dealing damage to enemies in front of you.

1879322297.name: Steed of the Woodland Realm

1879378361.name: Fiery Red Beetle

1879402681.name: Elk of the Spring Wood
